turns.speaker: moshi
turns.text: Hey, how's your day been so far?

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: My knives are so blunt I basically crush tomatoes instead of slicing them.

turns.speaker: moshi
turns.text: That's a sign they need sharpening. Do you have a sharpener or a whetstone at home?

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: Did the teacher say when the project's due, Darnell?

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: There's a little pull-through thing in the drawer. Never used it.

turns.speaker: moshi
turns.text: That'll help. Pull the blade through gently, five or six times, always in the same direction.

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: And how do I know if it worked?

turns.speaker: moshi
turns.text: Try slicing a sheet of paper. If it cuts cleanly without tearing, you're good.

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: Huh. My uncle says you should never put knives

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: in the dishwasher. Is that true?

turns.speaker: moshi
turns.text: He's right. The heat and rattling dull the edge and can damage the handle. Hand wash and dry them straight away.
